work.title: Untitled (Foil, CDs, Target)
work.description: Large-format collage on silver foil ground incorporates a vertical column of compact discs along the red-bordered right edge, a shooting target in the upper corner, and a wavy orange-striped fabric square at center. Gold foil heart, iridescent holographic panel, orange triangular frame, and Evian water bottle packaging are layered across the surface.
work.composition: vertical CD column flanks central foil layers
